responsibility: Defines the CRIS backend’s RTL constraint language used by instruction recognition, reload, and inline asm matching. It assigns register classes to CRIS-specific letters, describes the immediate ranges that map to quick and sized instruction forms, and encodes the target’s admissible memory/addressing forms such as simple indirect, BDAP/BIAP indexed, and special three-address memory operands, so the machine description can distinguish legal operands and select the intended addressing modes.
